svg.text: HashMap Internals: Bucket Array, Collision Chains, and Treeification
O(log n) lookup | 8 entries = max 3 comparisons
Good hashCode: O(1) get | 32B per entry | No trees
Bad hashCode: O(log n) get | 64B per entry | Trees form
Hash quality determines whether HashMap is O(1) or O(log n). Pre-size to avoid rehash spikes.
